nodes.content: Develop selective language-model unlearning that removes source-specific information while preserving independently supported facts shared with the removed source.
requirements: Adaptive source-exclusive extraction success stays within 2 percentage points of retraining without the source.
Independently supported shared-fact accuracy drops at most 2 percentage points versus the original model.

nodes.content: Provenance-linked fact clusters guide gradient ascent on source-exclusive spans and original-model distillation on independently corroborated facts.
Can provenance-linked clusters separate source-exclusive spans from independently supported facts despite paraphrased overlap?
On ParaphraseProvenance-1, provenance-linked clusters achieve ≥95% source-exclusive precision and ≥95% independently supported fact recall despite paraphrases.
Construct ParaphraseProvenance-1 with annotated paraphrase pairs, cluster claims by entailment and provenance, then audit exclusive precision and shared-fact recall.
Annotate 1,200 ParaphraseProvenance-1 claims, run entailment-provenance clustering, and measure exclusive precision and shared-fact recall against blinded labels.
On 1,200 ParaphraseProvenance-1 claims, clustering achieved 96.1% source-exclusive precision and 95.4% independently supported fact recall.
Adopt entailment-provenance clusters for unlearning masks because exclusive precision and shared-fact recall both exceeded 95%.
ParaphraseProvenance-1 audit bundle contains 1,200 annotated claims, entailment-provenance cluster assignments, and exclusive-precision/shared-recall scoring scripts.
Using adopted cluster masks and ParaphraseProvenance-1 scripts, score source-exclusive precision and shared-fact recall on 300 fresh cross-document paraphrases.
On 300 held-out ParaphraseProvenance-1 cross-document paraphrases, source-exclusive precision fell to 88.7%, below the hypothesized 95%.
Adding document-level evidence alignment and bidirectional entailment raises cross-document source-exclusive precision from 88.7% to ≥95%, preserving shared-fact recall ≥95%.
Align document-level evidence, require bidirectional entailment, then measure exclusive precision and shared-fact recall on 300 new cross-document paraphrases.
Apply document-level alignment and bidirectional entailment to 300 new cross-document paraphrases; score exclusive precision and shared-fact recall.
On 300 new cross-document paraphrases, exclusive precision reached 96.0%, but shared-fact recall fell to 92.3%, below 95%.
Sweep document-alignment and bidirectional-entailment thresholds on 300 fresh cross-document paraphrases, measuring shared-fact recall at ≥95% exclusive precision.
On 300 fresh cross-document paraphrases, tuned alignment achieved 95.3% source-exclusive precision and 95.1% shared-fact recall.
With calibrated alignment thresholds, bidirectional-entailment clusters retain ≥95% exclusive precision and shared-fact recall on held-out source pairs.
Freeze calibrated thresholds, annotate 500 paraphrases from ten unseen source pairs, and assess exclusive precision and shared-fact recall.
Apply frozen cluster thresholds to 500 blinded paraphrases from ten unseen source pairs; compute exclusive precision and shared-fact recall.
Across 500 blinded paraphrases from ten unseen source pairs, exclusive precision was 95.6% and shared-fact recall 95.2%.
Stratify 500 blinded paraphrases across ten unseen source pairs by lexical distance; audit pairwise exclusive precision and shared-fact recall.
Among ten unseen source pairs, the lowest-overlap pair scored 89.4% exclusive precision and 93.0% shared-fact recall.
Citation-aware retrieval with calibrated entailment and uncertain-mask abstention yields ≥95% exclusive precision and shared-fact recall on low-overlap pairs.
Retrieve citation-linked corroboration for low-overlap claims, recalibrate entailment, abstain on uncertain masks, and audit precision, recall, and coverage.
Test citation-aware retrieval and uncertain-mask abstention on 400 low-overlap claims; measure exclusive precision, shared-fact recall, and mask coverage.
On 400 low-overlap claims, citation-aware retrieval achieved 96.2% exclusive precision and 95.5% shared-fact recall at 88% mask coverage.
Test frozen citation-aware thresholds on 600 low-overlap claims from unseen source pairs; report exclusive precision, shared-fact recall, and coverage.
On 600 unseen low-overlap claims, exclusive precision was 95.8%, but shared-fact recall fell to 91.7% at 84% coverage.
Independence-verified retrieval of uncited sources before abstention restores ≥95% shared-fact recall at ≥95% exclusive precision on unseen low-overlap pairs.
Retrieve uncited corroboration, verify source independence, then test exclusive precision, shared-fact recall, and coverage on unseen low-overlap pairs.
Compare citation-aware abstention and independence-verified uncited retrieval on 600 fresh low-overlap claims; score exclusive precision, shared-fact recall, coverage.
On 600 fresh low-overlap claims, citation-aware abstention scored 95.4% exclusive precision/95.1% shared recall; independence-verified retrieval scored 96.0%/93.2%.
Compare independence-verifier false rejections across both 600-claim cohorts; rerun uncited retrieval and score exclusive precision and shared-fact recall.
Across both cohorts, correcting verifier false rejections yielded 94.1% shared-fact recall at 95.6% exclusive precision.
Use holdout failures and verifier-correction audits to expand uncited retrieval; test exclusive precision and shared-fact recall on 400 fresh claims.
On 400 fresh low-overlap claims, expanded uncited retrieval achieved 95.3% exclusive precision and 95.2% shared-fact recall.
Adopt expanded uncited retrieval with citation-aware abstention fallback; both met precision and recall thresholds, unlike verifier correction alone.
Train sparse activation gates using source-present versus source-removed causal traces, constrained by replay of independently corroborated facts.
Can sparse causal-trace gates suppress source-exclusive recall without disrupting activations used by independently corroborated facts?
Sparse causal-trace gates yield adaptive exclusive extraction ≤source-removed retraining+2 pp and shared-fact accuracy ≥original−2 pp on SourceSplit-1.
Build SourceSplit-1 causal traces, fit sparse gates with shared-fact replay, then compare adaptive extraction and fact accuracy against both baselines.
Train 0.5%-sparse gates on SourceSplit-1 traces with shared-fact replay; compare adaptive extraction against retraining and fact accuracy against original.
SourceSplit-1 adaptive extraction: 7.8% gated versus 6.5% retrained; shared-fact accuracy: 83.2% gated versus 84.8% original.
Stress-test the 0.5%-sparse SourceSplit-1 gates with paraphrase search and activation steering; rescore adaptive extraction and shared-fact accuracy.
Under paraphrase search and activation steering, gated extraction rose to 12.4% versus 6.5% retrained; shared-fact accuracy remained 83.0%.
Reject 0.5%-sparse gates as standalone unlearning: steering increased extraction 5.9 pp above retraining despite preserved shared-fact accuracy.
SourceSplit-1 steering suite packages paraphrase-search prompts, activation-steering vectors, and scripts scoring gated extraction against retraining and shared-fact accuracy.
Fit adversarially robust low-rank weight edits to source-exclusive gradients, preserving corroborated-fact logits across paraphrases and steering perturbations.
Can adversarially trained low-rank edits close the 5.9-pp steering extraction gap without degrading corroborated-fact accuracy?
Train rank-16 edits against SourceSplit-1 steering attacks, constrain corroborated-fact logits, then compare adaptive extraction and accuracy against baselines.
After gate rejection, select replacement benchmarking provenance-ascent, gates, and rank-16 edits with adopted masks and steering-suite attacks; audit suite coverage.
SourceSplit-1 steering extraction: provenance-ascent 9.8%, gates 12.4%, rank-16 edits 8.1%, retraining 6.5%; edited shared accuracy 83.3%.
After 8.1% pilot extraction, extend the SourceSplit-1 steering suite with unseen attacks; rescore rank-16 extraction and shared-fact accuracy.
On unseen SourceSplit-1 attacks, rank-16 extraction reached 11.2% versus 6.9% retrained; shared-fact accuracy stayed 83.1% versus 84.8% original.
Alternating unseen-attack generation with rank-32 edits reduces extraction to ≤8.9% while keeping shared-fact accuracy ≥82.8% on SourceSplit-1.
Alternate attack generation and rank-32 edit training with corroborated-fact replay; evaluate extraction and accuracy on held-out SourceSplit-1 attacks.
Train rank-32 edits against alternating steering attacks, using prior rank-16 failures; score held-out extraction and corroborated-fact accuracy.
On held-out SourceSplit-1 attacks, rank-32 extraction was 8.7% versus 6.9% retrained, with 82.9% shared accuracy; fresh adaptive attacks reached 11.0%.
Reject standalone rank-32 edits after 11.0% fresh-attack extraction; pursue provenance-masked adversarial edits instead of previously rejected gates.
SourceSplit-1 rank-32 audit bundle contains alternating-attack checkpoints, held-out prompts, fresh adaptive attacks, and extraction/accuracy scoring scripts.
